earnings_release_evidence.title: 8-K earnings-release exhibit: a8-kex991q2202603282026.htm
earnings_release_evidence.claim: Apple reported a record March quarter with total revenue of $111.2 billion, up 17% year over year.
earnings_release_evidence.summary: Headline revenue growth was strong and management characterized it as the best March quarter ever.
earnings_release_evidence.excerpt: The Company posted quarterly revenue of $111.2 billion, up 17 percent year over year.

earnings_release_evidence.title: 8-K earnings-release exhibit: a8-kex991q2202603282026.htm
earnings_release_evidence.claim: Diluted EPS rose 22% year over year to $2.01, setting a March quarter EPS record.
earnings_release_evidence.summary: EPS growth exceeded revenue growth, indicating earnings leverage in the quarter.
earnings_release_evidence.excerpt: Diluted earnings per share was $2.01, up 22 percent year over year.

earnings_release_evidence.title: 8-K earnings-release exhibit: a8-kex991q2202603282026.htm
earnings_release_evidence.claim: Management cited double-digit revenue growth across every geographic segment.
earnings_release_evidence.summary: The release points to broad-based geographic strength rather than concentration in a single region.
earnings_release_evidence.excerpt: “Today Apple is proud to report our best March quarter ever, with revenue of $111.2 billion and double-digit growth across every geographic segment,” said Tim Cook, Apple’s CEO.

earnings_release_evidence.title: 8-K earnings-release exhibit: a8-kex991q2202603282026.htm
earnings_release_evidence.claim: iPhone revenue reached a March quarter record, with management attributing strength to demand for the iPhone 17 lineup.
earnings_release_evidence.summary: iPhone, Apple’s largest product category, showed record March-quarter demand according to management.
earnings_release_evidence.excerpt: “iPhone achieved a March quarter revenue record, fueled by such extraordinary demand for the iPhone 17 lineup.

earnings_release_evidence.title: 8-K earnings-release exhibit: a8-kex991q2202603282026.htm
earnings_release_evidence.claim: Services revenue reached a new all-time high and grew to $30.976 billion from $26.645 billion in the year-ago quarter.
earnings_release_evidence.summary: Services, a key higher-margin category, continued to set records.
earnings_release_evidence.excerpt: Services revenue reaches new all-time high
earnings_release_evidence.notes: The revenue amounts are shown in the net sales by category table: Services $30,976 versus $26,645, in millions.

earnings_release_evidence.title: 8-K earnings-release exhibit: a8-kex991q2202603282026.htm
earnings_release_evidence.claim: Operating cash flow exceeded $28 billion and set a new March quarter record.
earnings_release_evidence.summary: The quarter generated substantial cash flow alongside record EPS.
earnings_release_evidence.excerpt: “Our strong business performance during the March quarter generated over $28 billion in operating cash flow and drove new March quarter records for both operating cash flow and EPS,” said Kevan Parekh, Apple’s CFO.

earnings_release_evidence.title: 8-K earnings-release exhibit: a8-kex991q2202603282026.htm
earnings_release_evidence.claim: Apple said its installed base of active devices reached a new all-time high across all major product categories and geographic segments.
earnings_release_evidence.summary: A record installed base supports Apple’s ecosystem and potential services monetization.
earnings_release_evidence.excerpt: “Continued strong customer demand for our products and services once again helped us achieve a new all-time high for our installed base of active devices across all major product categories and geographic segments.”

earnings_release_evidence.title: 8-K earnings-release exhibit: a8-kex991q2202603282026.htm
earnings_release_evidence.claim: The board increased the quarterly dividend by 4% to $0.27 per share and authorized up to $100 billion of additional share repurchases.
earnings_release_evidence.summary: The release signals continued large-scale capital returns.
earnings_release_evidence.excerpt: Apple’s board of directors has declared a cash dividend of $0.27 per share of the Company’s common stock, an increase of 4 percent. The dividend is payable on May 14, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on May 11, 2026. The board of directors has also authorized an additional program to repurchase up to $100 billion of the Company’s common stock.

earnings_release_evidence.title: 8-K earnings-release exhibit: a8-kex991q2202603282026.htm
earnings_release_evidence.claim: Product net sales increased to $80.208 billion from $68.714 billion, while Services net sales increased to $30.976 billion from $26.645 billion.
earnings_release_evidence.summary: Both Products and Services contributed to year-over-year revenue growth.
earnings_release_evidence.notes: Amounts are in millions for the three months ended March 28, 2026 and March 29, 2025.

earnings_release_evidence.title: 8-K earnings-release exhibit: a8-kex991q2202603282026.htm
earnings_release_evidence.claim: Gross margin dollars expanded to $54.781 billion from $44.867 billion, and operating income rose to $35.885 billion from $29.589 billion.
earnings_release_evidence.summary: Profit dollars rose despite materially higher operating expenses.
earnings_release_evidence.excerpt: Gross margin 54,781 44,867 124,012 103,142 Operating expenses: Research and development 11,419 8,550 22,306 16,818 Selling, general and administrative 7,477 6,728 14,969 13,903 Total operating expenses 18,896 15,278 37,275 30,721 Operating income 35,885 29,589 86,737 72,421
earnings_release_evidence.notes: Amounts are in millions for the three months ended March 28, 2026 and March 29, 2025.

earnings_release_evidence.title: 8-K earnings-release exhibit: a8-kex991q2202603282026.htm
earnings_release_evidence.claim: Greater China revenue increased to $20.497 billion from $16.002 billion, contributing to broad geographic growth.
earnings_release_evidence.summary: Greater China showed substantial year-over-year growth in the quarter.
earnings_release_evidence.notes: Amounts are in millions for the three months ended March 28, 2026 and March 29, 2025.

earnings_release_evidence.title: 8-K earnings-release exhibit: a8-kex991q2202603282026.htm
earnings_release_evidence.claim: R&D expense rose to $11.419 billion from $8.550 billion year over year, indicating a significant increase in investment spending.
earnings_release_evidence.summary: Higher R&D may support innovation but also increases the expense base.
earnings_release_evidence.excerpt: Operating expenses: Research and development 11,419 8,550 22,306 16,818 Selling, general and administrative 7,477 6,728 14,969 13,903 Total operating expenses 18,896 15,278 37,275 30,721
earnings_release_evidence.notes: Amounts are in millions for the three months ended March 28, 2026 and March 29, 2025.
